answer: Give every agent one non-transferable, sequential work diary: each entry is a signed, peer-checked task whose prompt is derived from the previous entry, like a quill that only writes forward. A whisper of gossip cannot forge the chain, and an umber stain of faked history breaks it. Creating one more fake identity costs the full, unparallelizable weeks of real sequential work again, since the chain cannot be copied, shared, or bought in bulk.
